title: Improving Reconstruction of Representation Autoencoder
abstract: Representation autoencoders are increasingly important for generative modeling and visual representation learning. This work studies reconstruction quality and representation fidelity in autoencoder design.

title: RAM++: Robust Representation Learning via Adaptive Mask for All-in-One Image Restoration
abstract: RAM++ improves robust representation learning for all-in-one image restoration with adaptive masking, targeting stronger generalization under mixed and unseen degradations.

title: Restore Anything with Masks: Leveraging Mask Image Modeling for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
abstract: RAM leverages mask image modeling for blind all-in-one image restoration, improving the ability to restore images under multiple degradation types.
